parts:
Hi All, 

I am new to multispecies occupancy and unmarked. 

Trying to run this section of coding and getting the error message for the 'for' loop. 
Error in [date.frame(occ_covs, , i): undefined columns selected.

y_species <- list(Human_mat,
               Tiger_mat,
               Leopard_mat)
names(y_species) <- c("Human", "Tiger", "Leopard")

occ_covs <- as.data.frame(cbind(LPrey_cov, SPrey_cov, APrey_cov, Livestock_cov, LC_cov, FC_cov, Block_cov, Loc_cov))

for(i in 7:13){occ_covs[,i] <- as.numeric(occ_covs[,i])}

det_covs <- list(DRoad_cov, DVillage_cov, DWater_cov, Livestock_cov, LPrey_cov, SPrey_cov, APrey_cov, HabT_cov)
names(det_covs) <- c("Distance Road", "Distance Village", "Distance Water", "Livestock", "Large Prey", "Small Prey", "All Prey","Habitat Type")

Any suggestions greatly appreciated. Thanks, Amy.
